ACME UTILITY CORP

Annual Report on Form 10-K

Item 1. Business

CSS_FIXTURE_ITEM1_PREAMBLE_TOKEN. ACME Utility Corp ("the Company") is a vertically integrated electric utility holding company serving a large, growing footprint of data-center and industrial load.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

CSS_FIXTURE_ITEM1A_REAL_BODY_TOKEN. Our business is subject to numerous risks, including regulatory delays in large-load interconnection approvals, wildfire liability across our service territory, elevated interest rates affecting our cost of capital, and physical and transition risks associated with climate change. A prolonged delay in obtaining regulatory approval for new data-center interconnection requests could materially and adversely affect our projected capital expenditures and anticipated revenue growth. We continue to monitor these risks closely and have expanded our enterprise risk management function accordingly to address emerging large-load and grid-reliability exposures across every operating region we serve.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

CSS_FIXTURE_ITEM7_REAL_BODY_TOKEN. The following discussion and analysis should be read together with our audited consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes included elsewhere in this report. Capital expenditures increased significantly year over year, driven primarily by transmission and substation upgrades required to serve new large-load interconnection requests from data-center customers across our regulated service territory. Management expects this trend to continue over the next several fiscal years as additional large-load requests move through the interconnection queue and enter construction.
